Commentary.Commentary: 168 then, needed for Australia to go on top. It is by no means an easy target and on a sluggish pitch against a quality bowling attack, it becomes even more difficult. More testing times await... stay tuned for the run chase.

A forgetful outing for the 2016 finalists. They were tested big time by Kaur and Mandhana but struggled to cope up. Eventually, the experienced Ellyse Perry had to be called upon to pick up wickets. Plenty of lessons to learn for the bowling unit from this encounter.

India were looking good for a score in excess of 175-180 but the captain's dismissal stemmed the runs a bit. 50 runs came after Kaur's wicket, in 39 balls, which could easily have been 70 had she been there. The continuous flow of wickets put the pressure on Mandhana as well who could not quite stay till the end.

Australia started well, getting Taniya Bhatia early but then Mandhana and Rodrigues had a decent stand of 44, which was followed by a magnificent partnership of 68 in just 42 balls for the third wicket. Kaur played a cameo while Smriti was in her own league, coming out of a rough patch. However, with the skipper's wicket, the bowling side managed to stem the flow a little.

A little bit of minimized damage by Australia towards the end of the innings but a big total nevertheless in front of them. Add to that, they might not have the consistent Alyssa Healy at the top of the order. Their usually consistent bowling has been carted all around the park here.
OUT! You miss and Ellyse hits. 3/16 in 3 overs in her 100th T20I. Full and straight, Deepti swings early and misses. The ball hits the timber and that ends the innings. INDIA FINISH ON 167/8!
Landed outside off, a touch wide, slashed down to third man for a run. Well done. Hands the strike over to Deepti.
2 balls left. Radha Yadav to face at least one of those.
OUT! Gone this time. Another length ball outside off, Reddy looks to go over mid off once again but cannot quite clear the substitute Nicole Bolton over there. A good leaping catch taken.
FOUR! Up and over! A length ball outside off, Arundhati hits this over mid off and gets a boundary!
Short ball, pulled through square leg for a single.

SAFE AS A HOUSE. A short ball, outside off, Deepti pulls it through mid-wicket and takes a single. She is pushed into the second by Hemalatha and is gone for all money but the fielder throws it at the wrong end. To the bowler, where Dayalan is comfortably in. Had she thrown it to the keeper, Deepti would have been a goner. The bowler then collects and throws it to the keeper and then appeals but too late...
And a run out appeal first up... referred upstairs...
Ellyse Perry to bowl the final over.
Tucks this behind square leg for one. Just 5 singles and a wicket from that over, could have had two. Schutt finishes with 4-0-30-1.
Goes for another slog but mistimes it so badly that even the top edge does not carry to long on. A run taken.
Around middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.

The physio is having a look at Alyssa Healy who is taking deep breaths. Does not look good at all. She gingerly gets up and IS WALKING OFF THE FIELD. Big blow to Australia. Thankfully for them, they have a wicket-keeper in the side, in Beth Mooney.

TOP EDGE, DROPPED AND A COLLISION! Alyssa Healy is down on the ground. This looks serious. A length ball, around middle, probably the leg cutter, Arundhati looks to pull but gets a top edge because she is too early into it. The top edge goes high and both the bowler and keeper go for it. Neither call though and Healy's face smashes into the shoulder of Schutt. The bowler is fine but the keeper seems to be knocked out. A single taken.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Arundhati Reddy walks in at number 8, replacing Mandhana.

OUT! No century for Mandhana but she has done her job. Full and around middle, Smriti looks to club it over the leg side but could not quite find the timing. Found Ellyse Perry though, to perfection, at deep mid-wicket. Fabulous knock from Mandhana. Can Australia make use of these final 11 balls?
Megan Schutt to bowl the penultimate over. 3-0-25-0 so far. Can India get to 180?
Full and outside off, Sharma looks to run it down to third man but misses. 17 from the over, Kimmince finishes with 4-0-42-2!
Full and outside off, lofted over point. Megan Schutt gives it a good chase and keeps the batters down to three.
FOUR! Insult to injury. Full and around off, Mandhana gets down and mows it over mid-wicket for a boundary!

MISSED STUMPING! WIDE as well. A full toss wide outside off, Smriti comes down the track but misses the ball. Poor Alyssa Healy is having a nightmare behind the stumps. Does not see the ball at all and it lands at her feet and then deflects off her left boot behind. Two runs taken.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
SIX! TONK! 1000 T20I RUNS FOR SMRITI MANDHANA! Just the second fastest Indian after Mithali Raj to do so. Full and down the leg side, Mandhana gets down and slogs it over square leg for a biggie!
Full on middle, Deepti uses her bottom hand and swings it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Delissa Kimmince is back on. 3-0-25-2 so far.

Backs away to the leg side, giving herself to a bit of room, Perry follows her and bowls it around leg. Smriti can only push it towards point. Excellent over from Perry - just a run and a wicket from it. 2-0-8-1 so far.
Full and outside off, Mandhana swings early and misses.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
On middle, clipped towards mid-wicket. A bit of a yes-yes and a no-no between the batters and eventually, they decide against the run.
Deepti Sharma walks in at number 7, replacing Hemalatha.

OUT! Drags it on! Perry strikes and manages to smile. A slower delivery, shorter in length, outside off, Hemalatha looks to pull but is done in by the lack of pace. Gets an inside edge which hits the stumps on the bounce.
Excellent yorker, right on middle, well dug out.
Ellyse Perry is back on. 1-0-7-0 so far.
FOUR! On middle, Mandhana slogs it over square leg for a boundary!
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
Dayalan Hemalatha comes in at number 6, replacing Krishnamurthy.

OUT! That is a stunning catch! Tayla Vlaeminck, take a bow. Short and outside off, Krishnamurthy goes back and pulls it over square leg. Looks like it will clear the infield but Vlaeminck over there leaps to perfection to take a brilliant catch! Unbelievable.
Full and outside off, chipped over cover for one.
Full and around middle, Krishnamurthy looks to slog but mistimes it high in the air. Does not carry to long on. A run taken.
Full on middle, Mandhana comes down the track and flicks it over mid-wicket for a single.
Ashleigh Gardner returns. 2-0-17-1 so far.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one. Not Sophie's day - 4-0-45-0 today.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Eases it down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

NOT OUT! Dear me... that was pitching outside leg and Mandhana was ready to walk off! Massive moment in the game. Australia were just seconds away from getting both the set batters out. Smriti missed her sweep and was hit on the pads. Molineux appealed and the umpire raised her finger. SM was ready to walk off but Veda stopped her and convinced her to go for the review. Hawk Eye proves Veda to be correct!
Mandhana has been adjudged LBW! She is happy to walk off but at the last moment, goes for the review.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, paddled over short fine leg for a boundary!
WIDE. Full and fired outside leg, Mandhana looks to sweep but misses.
Sophie Molineux to bowl out. 3-0-37-0 so far.
Full and outside off, driven through cover for one. 11 runs but a wicket as well from the over.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Veda Krishnamurthy comes in at number 5, replacing Kaur.

OUT! Caught! Kaur departs and Australia find the breakthrough at last. Full and outside off, Kaur looks to slog across the line but the ball is a touch wide and induces a top edge. It goes straight up in the air and Rachael Haynes at point makes no mistake. Harmanpreet is not too perturbed with her dismissal. She indicates a thumbs up to Mandhana, probably indicating her to keep going on. The 68-run stand in 42 balls has been broken. Fine cameo from the captain.
FOUR! More bad bowling. A leg side full toss when your fine leg is up inside the circle, with no one in the deep patrolling the boundary. Kaur paddles it over short fine leg!
FOUR! Welcome back into the attack! Full and outside off, Kaur reaches out and lofts it over cover. The ball almost goes the distance! Bounces just in front.
Delissa Kimmince is back on. 2-0-14-1 so far.
Outside off, punched straight to point.
WIDE. Poor ball, way down the leg side, Smriti cannot connect with her full.
Full and outside off, played through point for one.
Another long hop, probably a slower one. Kaur is early into her pull and gets a bottom edge to the leg side.
Short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, Mandhana looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which is gathered by the keeper on the bounce.
Full and straight, pushed through mid-wicket for a single.
Megan Schutt is back. 2-0-21-0 so far.
Pushes this through long on for a run. 14 from the over, Molineux has gone for 37 in her 3 overs!
SIX! THWACK! Insult to injury. The 50-RUN STAND IS UP IN 32 BALLS! Full on middle, Kaur jumps down the track and sends it flying over long off!

FIVE WIDES! Australia's bowling is getting ragged now. Sees Kaur jump out and Molineux fires it down the leg side. The idea is nice but the execution is not that great. It is too far down the leg side and Alyssa Healy is blinded. Cannot collect and the ball goes off her gloves to the fine leg fence.
Comes down the track and hits it over the bowler, towards long off for a run.
Full and outside off, Mandhana looks to drive but misses.
Comes down the track but on seeing that, Molineux shortens the length and bowls it quicker. Kaur adjusts and punches it through the covers for a single.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
Sophie Molineux returns. 2-0-23-0 so far.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run. The skipper wants the second but then sends Mandhana back. Just in time.
Full and wide outside off, Harmanpreet looks to fetch that and play the sweep but misses. The keeper misses behind too and the ball goes off her pads to short third man.
FOUR! Neatly done! Full and wide outside off, Kaur reaches out and steers it over backward point for a boundary!
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Full and around off, driven wide of mid off for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through point for a single.
WIDE. Miles outside off, left alone.
Delissa Kimmince is back on. 1-0-6-1 so far.
Pushes this through mid on for a run. 14 from the over, 24 from the last 2! Australia feeling the heat now. Probably for the first time in the tournament.
SIX! What a shot! Kaur is stepping it on! Full and outside off, Harmanpreet comes down the track and lofts it cleanly over extra cover!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pushes this through mid off for a single.

FOUR! 6th T20I Fifty for Mandhana, second against Australia and her first in this WT20! She is a big match player. Coming into this tournament, she was not in the best of forms but persisted with that strategy. Has paid off well today. Gets to the milestone with a powerful sweep past short fine leg!
Down the leg side, a full toss, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Ashleigh Gardner is back on. 1-0-3-1 so far.

SIX! THUNDEROUS! That is into the stands! Harmanpreet gets going nicely. Full and around middle, Kaur comes down the track and swings it powerfully over mid-wicket! 10 from that over, Molineux has gone for 23 in her 2 overs.
Down the leg side, flicked through long on for one.
Full on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Jumps out of her crease and thumps it towards long off for a single.
Pushes this through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Sophie Molineux is back on. 1-0-13-0 so far.
FOUR! THUMP! Full and around off, Mandhana hits it straight back over the bowler, one bounce and into the ropes!

DIRECT HIT WOULD HAVE HAD KAUR. A short ball outside off, Harmanpreet pulls it wide of mid on and calls for a quick single. The fielder gets to her right and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had she hit, she would have got the skipper.
Full and straight, Kaur was probably looking to flick initially but then at the last moment, adjusts on seeing the length, blocking it back to the bowler.
Full and down the leg side, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a run. Mandhana moves to 40 from 26 balls.
On a length around off, punched towards mid off.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Ellyse Perry comes on to bowl. It is her 100th T20I.
Another single taken down the ground, towards long on. 6 runs and a wicket from that over.
Pushes this down to long on for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed wide of cover for a quick single.
Skipper Harmanpreet Kaur comes in at number 4, replacing Rodrigues.

OUT! Great catch! Another fine piece of fielding. This time, it is Elysse Villani. Full and wide outside off, Rodrigues looks to drive it through the off side but gets a thick outside edge, due to the ball moving away a fraction. It flies low to short third man but Villani over there keeps her eyes on the ball and takes it inches above the surface! Australia needed that breakthrough. The partnership was beginning to open up.
Excellent fielding by Beth Mooney! Around off, Rodrigues flicks it wide of long on. Beth Mooney runs across to her right from long on, puts in a dive and saves the boundary. Two runs taken.
Full and around middle, going away, pushed with soft hands wide of mid off for a single.
Delissa Kimmince introduced now.
Outside off, chopped down to short third man where a misfield allows a single. 46/1 IN THE POWERPLAY, with 34 coming in the last 3!
FOUR! More runs! The length is a touch shorter and Mandhana just opens the face of her bat at the last moment, guiding it between short third man and backward point!
SIX! THRASH! Boy, Mandhana is coming into her own now. Full and around off, Smriti comes forward and lofts it miles over long on!
A little bit of shimmy to the leg side, working the ball to the leg side and keeping the scoreboard moving.
Goes short and Mandhana instantaneously pulls. Almost finds deep mid-wicket to perfection. A single taken as the ball drops just short.
Outside off, played straight to backward point.
Full and straight, defended back to the bowler. 13 from this over, India stepping it up.
WIDE. Fired down the leg side, pressure on the bowler, Jemimah misses out on the sweep.
Comes down the track now and pulls it over mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! How is that for batting? If the previous one was a swing, using more of muscle, this one was pure placement. Mandhana expected this to be much quicker and was prepared for it. Went back and steered it late past short third man for a boundary!
SIX! Lovely hit again! Full and around off, Mandhana comes forward and swings it cleanly through the line, clearing mid on and even the long on fence!

On middle and leg, worked through fine leg. There is a miscommunication between the batters with Mandhana wanting the single but Rodrigues had barely moved. She started to move when the fielder at short fine leg put in a dive and was gone for all money when the throw was released. Luckily for her, it was a weak one and she managed to make it.
Sophie Molineux into the attack now.
This time she miscues it but the ball goes beyond extra cover and lands safely. Two runs taken.

FOUR! Up and over! Mandhana is looking good today. A length ball, around off, Smriti walks forward a couple of steps and lofts it over mid off for a boundary. Not over-hitting that, just using the pace of the bowler and the fielding restrictions. Moves to 12 from 12 balls, with her second boundary. The stand is now worth 13 from 12 balls.
This time she connects, but finds point.
On a length outside off, Mandhana looks to force it through the off side but is cramped for room and is beaten.
Nice-looking shot, playing on the up, driving it past extra cover and wide of mid off for a run.
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a quick single.
Megan Schutt to bowl now.
On middle and leg, played straight to square leg.

WIDE. Loose delivery, down the leg side, SM looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball moves away after pitching and Alyssa Healy cannot quite stop it with a dive to her right. Parries it towards fine leg and a single is taken.
A short ball, holds off the surface, Smriti looks to pull but mistimes it towards short mid-wicket.
Another cracking shot, but this time Sophie Molineux dives at short extra cover to stop the ball.
FOUR! Fine shot! A length ball outside off, Mandhana comes down the track and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Full and outside off, Jemimah steers it behind point for a single.
A slower bouncer to start the over, Rodrigues ducks.
Outside off, punched straight to point. 3 runs and a wicket from that over for Gardner.
Jemimah Rodrigues comes in at number 3, replacing Bhatia.

OUT! Gardner strikes! India lose their first pretty early. Full and outside off, like the second ball of this over, once again Bhatia jumps out of the crease. Again, she wants to go straight but is consumed by the turn and dip. Miscues it once more and Meg Lanning at short mid-wicket takes a good catch.
Short and outside off, played late towards short third man.
Now Mandhana comes down the track and chips it over cover for a run.

IN THE AIR... SAFE! Bhatia looking to take the bowler on. Jumps out of the crease and looks to go straight but the ball turns and dips onto her and she miscues it towards mid-wicket. Luckily for her, the fielder from the deep cannot get to it. A single taken.  taken.
Full and outside off, Mandhana lunges to push but the ball holds off the surface. It flies in the air but wide of extra cover. A single to long off.
Ashleigh Gardner to bowl from the other end.
On middle and leg, swung aggressively towards deep square leg. Excellent start from the debutant. Just 2 runs from the opening over.
On a length outside off, punched straight to cover.
Down the leg side, helped through fine leg for a single. India are underway.
Ooohhh... a play and a miss. Full and outside off, slightly wide, Taniya has a flash but misses. That barely carried to Alyssa Healy.
Full and straight this time, watchfully defended.
Interesting stance. Bhatia stands well outside the leg stump, gets across and drives it straight to cover-point.

We are done with the national anthems are the players are back out on the field. Smriti Mandhana and Taniya Bhatia will open for India. Debutant Tayla Vlaeminck has been given the new ball straight away. Bhatia to face. Here we go!
The players walk out for their national anthems. Australia's will be first up.

PITCH REPORT - Leslie Murdoch observes that this is the second time that we will be having a WT20 game here after the Aus-NZ clash. Sees that there are three different portions of clay visible and the quicks should have a good outing. But also adds that there will be plenty of runs on offer.

Australian captain, Meg Lanning, says that she was looking to bowl anyways as the wicket looks good. Informs that there is one change - Georgia Wareham being benched for debutant Tayla Vlaeminick. On being asked about the same, Meg says that the change is because the Aussies feel that pace on this wicket would be a big help. Adds that the team is as best prepared as it can be for this tournament and the game.

Indian skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur, says that they want to set a decent total on the the board, hence the decision. Informs that the Indian side has gone in with two changes - Mithali Raj has been rested after getting hurt on her knee against Ireland and Anuja Patil comes in her place. The other change is Mansi Joshi being replaced by Arundhati Reddy. Smiles on being asked whether the inclusion of Arundhati is because of her success against Australia and puts it down to simple consistency. Adds that the Indian team is very confident and hopes to put on another good show today.
TOSS TIME! Harmanpreet Kaur will be the person to toss the coin, the call is Heads, but it is a Tail. INDIA WILL BAT FIRST.
WEATHER REPORT - It is slightly overcast as of now, but hopefully, the rain stays away.

It is always nice to see two strong teams playing against each other and from what we hear, this could be a dress rehearsal for the final. No disrespect for Windies or England though. Hopefully, we get a cracker.

Hello and a warm welcome for one final time in Guyana. It is that stage of the World Cup where  a loss or a win does not matter too much, with four teams already qualifying for the semis. But there will be positions to play for, with topping the league a nice incentive. It is Australia taking on India today.
